David looked at Emma's beautiful smile. All the pain of his recent breakup was gone. All his doubts and fears about A were dispelledFor love. He reached out and touched her hand.
I want to ask you something. David looked into her eyes. Did she expect what would happen?
Her smile made him feel brave. I held his hand. Don't worry. Whatever it is, I'll probably say yes!

Excuse me, he said to Emma. He pushed his chair back and went to the bathroom. As he looked in the mirror, he said to himself: Come on, David, come on! You can do it, my friend! She's in love with you!
